finbarre_verger.text: Welcome to St Fin Barre's. Finbarr, Cork's patron saint, set up a monastery on this spot in the 600s.
The cathedral was designed by William Burges and consecrated in 1870. He also did Cardiff Castle, so he knew his turrets.
Look up for the gilded angel on the east end, and count the three spires. Burges never met a spire he did not like.
